fields.statement: QA at c9e38ec85: go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza; GODEBUG=inittrace=1 rhiza-x version shows go-runewidth init 0.023-0.038 ms clock, 48 bytes (88516d956 build: 22 ms clock, 56472 bytes). 200-start loop alternated under the machine lock: old 7.14 s, 7.09 s; new 1.97 s, 2.09 s. go mod why -m names cmd/rhiza, charmbracelet/colorprofile, charmbracelet/x/ansi; go mod verify all modules verified; no replace directive; go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/tui/... ok. Old and new binaries give byte-identical output for slice --change (default and --budget 800), status, a bad change list call (exit 2 both) and a missing change set (exit 4, clean message). StringWidth of ASCII, CJK, emoji, flags, box drawing is unchanged between v0.0.27 and v0.0.31 by default; under RUNEWIDTH_EASTASIAN=1 or a ja_JP locale, e-acute goes from 2 to 1 (recorded as a minor finding).

QA at c9e38ec85: /usr/bin/time go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/slice -run '^TestFit$' ok in 2.67 s wall (was 42 s); go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/slice ok (19.0 s); TestCheckOrder passes, and its skip and go-back cases assert exact errors naming the budget and both states. Coverage: -coverprofile for TestFit here and in a detached worktree of 88516d956: 39 budget.go blocks covered in old.out, 0 missing in new.out. git diff from the merge-base leaves budget.go untouched; the brief-two-sections subtest now also asserts not over and exactly two cut, and TestFitWithin's comment no longer says TestFit sweeps every budget.
